DPR-10: edit controls and overlap warning

Browser screenshots use the real SiteEdit controls with synthetic fixture API data. No production/customer writes. The fixture validates draft-versus-version routing and overlap reason submission; this is not a production database test.

  • Bottom draft save: PATCH /api/dprs/6250/draft; no version attempt.
  • Bottom submitted edit: POST /api/dprs/6251/version.
  • Unchanged saved draft row 3+100–3+250: prior context delayed, then inline warning appeared for the 3+150–3+250 overlap. No-reason submit blocked; reason saved and POST /api/dprs/6253/submit succeeded.
  • Actual cause: a submitted-version unchanged-claim exemption had been applied to saved draft rows. Drafts no longer receive that exemption; the requirement for an overlap reason remains unchanged.
  • All 3,383 tests across 205 files and the build passed. No schema changes or publishing.

Material deliveries — investigation only

Site Material Trips are independent physical receipt records. Linking a trip to an activity does not copy it into dpr.materials. The separate Materials Log is intentional; the lack of a same-day trips indicator on the read-only report is a reporting gap. SiteReport displays its own empty Materials Log; SitePreview omits an empty materials section.

Recommended, not implemented: add a separate permission-controlled same-site/day material trips summary with total, activity-linked, and unlinked counts. Exclude cancelled/deleted trips and deduplicate each trip across activities. Do not merge deliveries into DPR consumption, stock movements, material abstracts, or BOQ credit.
